RETURN POLICY

We are committed to offering high quality products and strive to give you the customer service that you deserve. If for any reason you are not happy with your purchase, you may return the item(s) within 30 days for a refund back to the original form of payment, less the shipping charge. Please return items in original condition with all contents included. The customer will be responsible for any costs incurred while shipping the product back. Please contact us immediately by phone or email if your product arrives damaged from shipping or if you would like to return your product for a refund.

Because we cannot be responsible for packages mailed to us, we suggest that you use a trackable and insured mail service. Please allow up to 2 weeks from the time you mail your order for the return or exchange to be processed. An email will be sent to you once the return or exchange has been processed.
